archive_dir.description: Target directory for storing expired mailbox files. Default is the current directory.

age_in_days.description: Age in days. Messages older than this number of days are considered expired and moved.

mailboxes.description: List of mailbox files or directories to process. Supports mbox and Maildir formats.

unique_output.description: If true, if an existing archive file with the expected filename is found, another filename is chosen by appending a suffix.

target_filebase.description: Explicit output target file name for all inputs. Merges all expired mails into the same target mbox.

sfx_fmt.description: Format string for the date suffix in output filenames, compatible with strftime.

dry_run.description: If true, only examine input files and directories, no mail data is moved around.

delete_after_expire.description: If true, drop the old messages. No backup will be made.

keep_expired.description: If true, copy the expired messages to output files and keep them in the input file.

purge_level.description: How to remove input files or folders after becoming empty. 0: never, 1: remove empty files, 2: remove empty file and Maildir, 3: like 2 but also remove input if it was empty.

verbosity.description: Verbosity level. 0: no output except errors, 1: some progress messages, 2+: verbose.

compression.description: Compression method for output archives. Options: 'gzip', 'xz', 'zstd', 'none'.

lockless.description: If true, lockless operation. Input Mailboxes are assumed to be not touched by other tools.

shell_archive_cmd.description: A shell script fragment run to archive the data. Overrides default compression.
